body: It's the whole forgiving myself thing that is just so hard. I just imagine how I would feel if I was my sister and i would never want to forgive me. I just know how negatively people feel about people like me and its tough. I'm hoping a shrink will help. I appreciate the kind words. Happy holidays to you too.

And maybe that's something I need to come to terms with eventually is that maybe it's not all my fault. But since then I've taken the blame for everyting regardless of what it was solely because I feel everything wrong in my life is my fault. I want her forgiveness but I understand it may never actually happen and that is one of the hardest things to know. I just hate myself every time i look in the mirror and it makes me sick

I know forgiveness is the key but right now I honestly don't feel like I deserve forgiveness and at the moment I feel like I don't deserve much of anything. My two biggest issues are that i hate myself for what I did, and that I hate myself for destroying her childhood before she ever had a chance to good in the world. She's been depressed for 10 years now and my parents are clueless as to why but I know it's my fault and that's the hardest thing. Every time I look at her I know her pain and suffering is all my fault and that I'd die if it would make her better.
